summary: Turn a completed sales conversation into a clear debrief, follow-up, CRM changes, and next actions.

useCases.title: Turn this sales meeting into clear next steps
useCases.message: Debrief this sales meeting using the transcript or notes. Tell me what changed, prepare the right follow-up and next actions, and show any proposed CRM updates separately before changing anything.

useCases.title: Help me follow through after this customer meeting
useCases.message: Debrief this customer or sales meeting for me. Give me the quick take, commitments, open questions, and the follow-through that matters most.

useCases.title: Debrief a client or new-business meeting
useCases.message: Turn this client or new-business meeting into a concise debrief, owned actions, and a follow-up draft grounded in what was actually said.

useCases.title: Turn this client conversation into action
useCases.message: Debrief this client conversation and help me capture what changed, what I promised, and what should happen next.
